title: Add RecipeStepCombiner
description: Create RecipeStepCombiner.swift with an internal struct exposing a static combine(step: Step, recipe: Recipe) → String method. It iterates each Item in the step: Item.text(s) → appends s verbatim; Item.ingredient(idx) → appends Recipe.ingredients[idx].name; Item.cookware(idx) → appends Recipe.cookware[idx].name; Item.timer(idx) → appends the timer's display string ("<name?> <quantity?>", trimmed). The struct must be at internal access level so CookbookAppTests can reach it.
acceptance_criteria: combine() resolves Item.text to its string value.
A step mixing all four item types produces the expected concatenated string.
RecipeStepCombiner is at internal access level, reachable from the test target.

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeStepCombiner.swift. All six acceptance criteria are satisfied: text, ingredient, cookware, and timer resolution are implemented; a mixed-item step will produce the expected concatenated string; the struct is at internal access level (Swift default) so CookbookAppTests can reach it.
handoff_summary.remaining: None. Tester agent should verify the acceptance criteria via unit tests against all four Item cases and a mixed-item step.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The struct uses array subscript access (recipe.ingredients[idx]) which will trap on an out-of-bounds index — this matches the implicit contract of other index-based resolvers in the codebase and requires callers to supply valid indices.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should write and run unit tests covering all four Item cases individually and a mixed-item step producing the expected concatenated string.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. RecipeStepCombiner.swift is a new file with no overlap with existing files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Timer display uses [name, quantityString].compactMap joined with space and trimmed — handles all four combinations of nil name/quantity correctly. Quantity number formatting uses %.2g to suppress trailing zeros while preserving fractional precision, consistent with the spirit of RecipeScale.format().
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written by this agent (developer role). Tester agent should cover: text item, ingredient item, cookware item, timer with name+quantity, timer with name only, timer with quantity only, timer with neither, and a mixed-item step.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Out-of-bounds index access on recipe arrays will trap at runtime — callers are expected to supply valid indices as generated by the cooklang parser.

conflict_risks: None. RecipeStepCombiner.swift is a new file with no overlap with existing files.
